name: meta-brute-wait-fails
description: T-030 negative test (user 2026-11-23: 'could do tests which expect the failure'): the Brute wait of dynamite-alerts-mobs (wait until + GunPowdered.noiseCreatureWithin + expect) must be able to FAIL - a Brute 40 m away is never within 0.5 m of the marked noise spot, so the wait runs out and the check fails with 'not within'. Lab a17ab6 showed a regex in `wait until` is not applied (the 12 s wait ended at once).

steps.name: GunPowdered.noiseMarkBlast
steps.label: mark the noise spot (the last blast, or none)

steps.name: GunPowdered.noiseCreatureWithin
steps.label: the Brute is within 0.5 m of the noise spot (must fail: 'not within')
